text_simplified: Supplication (du'a) is the key to all good and the weapon of the believer. Parents should supplicate abundantly for their children's guidance and righteousness, seeking times when prayers are answered—such as the last third of the night, between the adhan and iqamah, during prostration, when rain falls, and the final hour of Friday, following the example of Allah's prophets such as Ibrahim and Zakariyya (peace be upon them both), and the servants of the Most Merciful, who ask Allah to make their offspring a comfort to their eyes through their righteousness and obedience to Allah.
